subject: Novatek POC: evaluation guardrails, acceptance criteria & kickoff plan
messages:
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@novatek.com>, Adam Chen <adam.chen@novatek.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Novatek POC: evaluation guardrails, acceptance criteria & kickoff plan

Hi Elena / Adam — thanks again for a productive call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have shared expectations before we schedule the kickoff.

Call recap (key points):
- Goal: validate Redwood inference for conversational support at Novatek (English-only first phase).
- Target QPS and latency expectations discussed (see acceptance criteria below).
- Data: subset of historical chat logs and a small syn dataset for edge cases.
- Compliance: no customer PII will be uploaded during POC; logs retained for 30 days unless otherwise agreed.

Proposed success / acceptance criteria (please confirm):
1) Functional correctness — top-line intent handling: >= 85% accuracy on the provided evaluation set (client-provided labels).
2) Latency — 95th percentile inference latency < 350ms for 4k context at peak test load (25 concurrent sessions).
3) Throughput — sustain 60 QPS during load window with acceptable error rate (<1%).
4) Stability — no more than 2 incidents requiring manual intervention during the 4-week trial.
5) Integration — REST API + optional webhook routing working with your QA harness.

Proposed timeline & milestones:
- Week 0: Kickoff, access + onboarding (calendar options below).
- Week 1: Baseline ingest + model selection; first small-scale smoke tests.
- Week 2: Full evaluation run (functionality + load).
- Week 3: Iteration (prompt tuning / config adjustments).
- Week 4: Final readout + sign-off meeting.

Owners (suggested):
- Redwood: Marissa (sales lead), Ben (solutions / infra lead), Lauren (CS / success lead).
- Novatek: Elena (product owner), Adam (platform / infra), Alex (QA lead).

Attachments: I attached a draft acceptance matrix (novatek-poc-acceptance-matrix.xlsx) to capture test cases and measurement approach.

Calendar options for kickoff (PST): Thu Dec 10 9:00-10:00 / Thu Dec 10 14:00-15:00 / Mon Dec 13 11:00-12:00. Please confirm a time that works and any prep items your team wants added to the agenda.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this running.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.co@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Novatek POC: evaluation guardrails, acceptance criteria & kickoff plan

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming Novatek's alignment and a couple of tweaks: we agree with the structure but want to tighten the acceptance thresholds and add an X-failure mode check.

Updated acceptance criteria from Novatek:
- Functional correctness: target >= 88% on labeled intents; we'll provide the labeled set by EOD Friday.
- Latency: 95th < 300ms if possible; we understand this may depend on model variant — please call out variants you plan to use.
- Throughput: 70 QPS sustained (peak test).
- Regression check: compare to our baseline system on a 1000-sample readout; regressions > 3% on intent accuracy will be a blocker.

We can do the kickoff Thu Dec 10 at 14:00-15:00 PST. Agenda items to add: test dataset handoff procedure, access to our internal QA harness, and who will be point-of-contact for incident escalation.

Also — please include an SOW skeleton or any procurement language we should expect so our procurement team can start prepping.

Thanks — Elena
Elena Torres
Director, Product @ Novatek
elena@novatek.com

Hi all — confirmed: kickoff scheduled Thu Dec 10 14:00-15:00 PST (calendar invite sent). Quick technical notes ahead of the meeting so Elena/Adam/Alex have context: 

- Model variants we'll propose during kickoff: Redwood-Chat-13B (quantized low-latency build) and Redwood-Standard-13B (higher-quality, slightly higher latency). We'll present bench numbers for both.
- Initial bench (prelim): with 4k context on Redwood-Chat-13B quantized profile we see 95th ~ 280-320ms depending on batch window; engineer will bring concrete traces to kickoff.
- We will provide an S3-compatible ingest endpoint for your QA harness and a short runbook for test data handoff.

Agenda for kickoff (30/30 split):
1) Introductions & objectives (5 mins)
2) Acceptance criteria & measurement plan (10 mins)
3) Test harness & data handoff (10 mins)
4) Runtime config options & bench preview (10 mins)
5) Success metrics, schedule & RACI (10 mins)
6) Procurement next steps & SOW walk (5 mins)

Ben (solutions) will lead the technical segment; Lauren will lead onboarding and weekly cadence. Marissa will cover procurement/commercial.

See you all at 14:00 PST. I've uploaded the SOW skeleton and the acceptance matrix to the shared Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-novatek-poc-plan

Ben Carter
